js-variadic-sum.alternative: function sumAll(...numbers){let sum=0;for(const value of numbers)sum=sum+value;return sum;}
js-variadic-sum.wrong-round: function sumAll(...numbers){let sum=0;for(const value of numbers)sum+=value;return Math.round(sum*100)/100;}
js-variadic-sum.wrong-cap: function sumAll(...numbers){let sum=0;for(const value of numbers.slice(0,100))sum+=value;return sum;}

js-make-tally.alternative: function makeTally(start){let total=start;return (...values)=>{for(const value of values)total+=value;return total;};}
js-make-tally.wrong-round: function makeTally(start){let total=start;return (...values)=>{for(const value of values)total+=value;total=Math.round(total*100)/100;return total;};}

js-my-map-filter.alternative:
const myMap = (list, fn) => { const result = []; for (let index = 0; index < list.length; index += 1) result.push(fn(list[index], index)); return result; };
const myFilter = (list, fn) => { const result = []; for (let index = 0; index < list.length; index += 1) { if (fn(list[index], index)) result.push(list[index]); } return result; };
